items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: He got on the piano and he played what he wanted and we put a little background to it.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. There were little kids out of school, that's in there. They're only like fourteen. I did their, right, they were going to Clark. I did their first session, and I didn't know what they were going to do. But most of their stuff was similar. And a lot of that stuff got on the piano, I played baritone though. Leonard Lee, that's his name, he's still in New Orleans. He got on the piano and he played what he wanted and we put a little background to it. Most of those had arrangements? Yes, all of them were head…
Well how would Dave conduct a set?
